latest_release.name: v0.18.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Use built-in methods in bjson test by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1749
* Fix String.prototype.repeat with a large count on an empty string by @ethanstoner in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1741
* Port bellard/quickjs@10c81b1 to fix GCC 14+ performance regression by @gengjiawen in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1744
* Fix precision loss in performance.now() and timeOrigin by @josefguenther in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1746
* Fix use-after-free when JS_NewContext runs out of memory by @IamYipi in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1781
* Fix os.poll dispatch when a later descriptor is ready by @gengjiawen in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1786
* Update MSVC version for ARM64 builds in CI by @saghul in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1785
* Ensure function prototype is propagated when bound by @sr5434 in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1733
* Use mi_usable_size for the mimalloc usable-size hook by @saghul in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1788
* Pass JSContext to JSInterruptHandler by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1802
* Accept Unicode spaces in Date.parse by @goffrie in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1774
* Return false instead of error with undefined receiver in Reflect.set by @sr5434 in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1734
* Fix evaluation order of computed property assignment by @goffrie in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1780
* Record the source location of import() calls by @yspbwx2010 in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1755
* Fix leak in JSON.stringify when an array index can't be converted by @IamYipi in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1784
* Tweak GC-on-new-object heuristic by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1806
* Make OOM exceptions uncatchable by JS code by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1810
* docs: add DuckDB QuickJS extension to projects list by @rustyconover in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1812
* Make InternalErrors uncatchable by JS code by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1814
* Template literals convert substitutions too late (and look up String.prototype.concat) by @Iann29 in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1811
* Explain new security policy in SECURITY.md by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1818
* Upgrade macos-14 runners to macos-15 by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1830
* Fix infinite loop on allocation failure in unicode_script() by @Kayyo321 in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1829
* Export all API symbols in the QJS_WASI_REACTOR build by @effulgentsia in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1804
* Export the indirect function table in the WASI reactor and make it growable by @effulgentsia in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1841
* Fix leak in JS_ReadBigInt on truncated input by @theaddonn in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1840
* Cosmopolitan libc build by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1839
* Support asynchronous dynamic import() by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1860
* Fix use-after-free when freeing a WeakMap with symbol values by @wleeaf in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1844
* Array.fromAsync: use internal call instead of .call lookup (#1795) by @Chieler in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1832
* Use $RUNNER_TEMP instead of /tmp in CI recipes by @bnoordhuis in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1861

## New Contributors
* @ethanstoner made their first contribution in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1741
* @gengjiawen made their first contribution in https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/pull/1744
* @IamYipi made their first contribution in https://github.com

detail.readme:
# ⚡️ QuickJS - A mighty JavaScript engine

## Overview

QuickJS is a small and embeddable JavaScript engine. It aims to support the latest
[ECMAScript] specification.

This project is a _fork_ of the [original QuickJS project] by Fabrice Bellard and Charlie Gordon, after it went dormant, with the intent of reigniting its development.

## Getting started

Head over to the [project website] for instructions on how to get started and more
documentation.

## Authors

[@bnoordhuis], [@saghul], and many more [contributors].

[ECMAScript]: https://tc39.es/ecma262/
[original QuickJS project]: https://bellard.org/quickjs
[@bnoordhuis]: https://github.com/bnoordhuis
[@saghul]: https://github.com/saghul
[contributors]: https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/graphs/contributors
[project website]: https://quickjs-ng.github.io/quickjs/
